title: The Queen Pays the Rent
setup: Black's queen has spent the opening chasing pawns and has just taken one in the center. Find the sacrifice that sets up a knight fork.
hint: A knight jump to g5 would hit f7 and e4 at once. What would it take to make the black king stand on f7?
explanation:
## The Idea

The black queen has spent the opening grabbing pawns while White castled and developed, and the bill falls due now.

{{Bxf7+}} gives up the bishop to drag the king forward. If {{Kxf7}}, then {{Ng5+}} forks the king on f7 and the queen on e4, and the queen is lost.

Declining with {{Kd8}} keeps the queen but leaves the black king stranded in the middle, and White is winning anyway.

A queen that hunts pawns in the opening ends up hunted itself.
